current_scope: Same-step learned head functional operation only; no RL, step-reduction training, contraction experiment or new policy tuning authorized by this keep request.
hypothesis: Jointly decide tool and argument reuse versus new generation by predicting whether immediate generation cost is repaid by fewer downstream interactions at preserved answer quality.

example.reuse: An old query costs no new argument tokens but may need several more searches/reads.
example.generate: A newly generated query costs tokens now but may obtain the missing evidence in one search.

proposed_training_only_counterfactuals: From the identical observed train prefix, compare actual reuse and fresh-generation continuations. Record answer/support quality, total later primitive tool calls, backbone passes, generated tokens and costs. Gold answers/supports may label training outcomes but never enter runtime inputs.
objective: Minimize expected total remaining compute/tool cost subject to a calibrated answer-quality constraint. Do not reward short failed/unsupported trajectories as efficient.
distinguishing_question: Can a policy learn to spend MORE tokens now to require FEWER tool interactions later, outperforming separately optimized head routing and step penalties?
novelty_status: Hypothesis requiring validation and broader prior-art checking; not a first-of-kind claim. Head routing, selective rewriting, adaptive stopping and cost-aware search RL already exist.

closest_prior_art.overlap: Hidden-state latent retrieval plus retrieval-control head jointly removes intermediate query/stop text and reduces retrieval calls.
Keyword/semantic/read actions and quality-gated turn-efficiency RL.
Learns forward-looking STOP versus CONT value from trajectories.
Cost-aware selective query rewriting already explored; simple rewrite gating is not enough as novelty.

possible_differentiation_not_established: Argument-generation-specific counterfactual downstream value, not just retrieve-versus-stop.
Joint tool/argument-mode/remaining-cost decisions from shared native prefill with no extra inference judge.
Preserve existing A-RAG handlers/retriever/index rather than requiring a model-specific latent document index.
Demonstrate non-additive benefits over head-only, step-only and independently combined baselines at matched quality and total compute.
contraction_note: Future possibility only: predict grounded remaining work/value and test expected progress. Shrinking hidden-state distances, entropy or logit changes alone do not imply evidence sufficiency, correctness or a mathematical contraction guarantee.
measurement_note: Context compression, fewer decision rounds, fewer primitive tool executions and fewer decode tokens are different quantities. Report all and avoid renaming a macro-call as one cheap step.
resource_note: Frozen backbone/head-only learning may reduce gradient memory, but rollout inference remains costly. No new dataset expansion, GRPO job, model download or GPU sweep has been launched.
